originalSources.publisher: MIT Election Data and Science Lab (MEDSL)
originalSources.document: U.S. Senate precinct-level returns 2022 (state files, aggregated to county by this project)
originalSources.locator: Harvard Dataverse, dataverse.harvard.edu (MIT Election Data and Science Lab). Local copy: R/data/raw_election/senate_2022.raw; dataset DOIs: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/NLTQAD, https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/DGNAFS, https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/ER9XTV, https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/IAD3XR, https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/ZCM3BN
originalSources.obtained: downloaded via the Dataverse guestbook/signed-URL flow (R/data/raw_election/download_medsl.sh)
originalSources.transcription: none (parsed text); project fixes: pseudo-rows removed, party fixes, special elections excluded (see data_corrections_log.csv)
originalSources.license: CC0 1.0, verified 2026-09-23 via the Dataverse API (license field on the dataset record)
originalSources.notes: Special-election races excluded; Arizona 2020 (special only) is a gap
